about:
StraightUp Solar is a solar installation company based in St. Louis, Missouri, founded in 2006 and operating under the same ownership since its inception. The company was established to empower St. Louis area residents and businesses to take control of their energy with clean solar options.

The firm provides end-to-end solar photovoltaic services, including system design, installation, battery storage integration, EV charger installation, and ongoing operations and maintenance. Its full-time, in-house service department handles monitoring, troubleshooting, remove-and-reinstall work, and commissioning for both residential and commercial arrays. Since 2006, the team has completed more than 3,200 solar installations across eastern Missouri and central and southern Illinois.

StraightUp Solar serves homeowners as well as a diverse commercial client base that includes small businesses, nonprofits, schools, agricultural operations, government facilities, industrial sites, and houses of worship. The company manages grid-tied distributed generation projects that offset utility electricity use and provides monitoring portals for real-time production tracking.

The company emphasizes its continuity of ownership and a dedicated service department as key differentiators, aiming to remain a long-term solar partner for customers through design, build, and decades of system care.
